findings.title: align-items mixin passes modern values to legacy box properties
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin writes the modern value straight into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. The 2009 box spec and the IE10 spec use different keywords (`start`/`end` instead of `flex-start`/`flex-end`). Values like `flex-start` are therefore ignored or misapplied in those legacy engines. Separately, `-ms-align-items` is not a real property.

findings.title: order mixin ordinal-group mismatch across specs
findings.body: `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` is 1-based and defaults to 1, while `order` is 0-based and defaults to 0. Using the same value for both shifts the relative ordering of items in legacy browsers. With the `.panel` set to 3 and `.extra-info-wrapper` set to 2, any unordered items get order 0 in modern browsers but ordinal 1 in legacy ones, so the computed layouts differ between engines.

findings.title: Floats ignored inside new flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so the `float: right` on its button and `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` no longer apply. As a result, the button will sit immediately after the description instead of being pushed to the right edge.
